revision_disclosure: V1 failed demand/generation/structure. V2 separated electricity elasticity using only 2005-2014 and corrected initial margins: demand/generation improved, but one wind+solar combined target hid severe technology-mix errors. V3 splits their capacity targets at unchanged combined family weight and calibrates one bounded relative investment-response parameter. All revisions followed already-seen evaluation; never blind validation. Earlier versions and results retained.
revision_4_disclosure: V3 still overexpanded wind because construction capability automatically grew in proportion to every newly built asset. V4 bounds wind installation capability by initial construction capacity times GDP, separating fleet stock from construction-industry capacity; solar retains modular scaling. This disclosed structural revision uses no observed post-initial capacity as a driver; assessed on reused evaluation years.

assumptions.gdp_future_basis: Author conditional deceleration path, not official forecast; paired +/-1 percentage point and joint range
assumptions.wind_construction_basis: Initial max(trailing-three-year net additions,35% initial stock) x GDP ratio; construction capability, not fleet size; stress elasticity 0.5/1.5
assumptions.initial_cash_basis: 10 percent of reconstructed initial asset replacement cost; initial loans zero as a disclosed balance sheet reconstruction, tested by equity and funding counterexamples.
assumptions.income_basis: Service-income endowment covers energy purchases; financing inflows and internal transfers are recorded separately from national resource costs
assumptions.initial_pipeline_basis: Equal annual commissioning over lead time from trailing three-year net capacity additions, using only initial-year-and-earlier snapshots; no observed future additions
assumptions.initial_generation_cohorts: Uniform residual age over economic lifetime for pre-2009 stock, except nuclear ages limited to 1991-2009 by the first Chinese unit grid date; later positive observed net additions are separate cohorts; research retirement ages, not legal licence dates. Self-check corrected the earlier physically impossible pre-1991 nuclear cohorts.
assumptions.initial_device_cohorts: Uniform 1..15 remaining years; output capacities reconstructed from initial useful-service demand and 60% duty; no plant/device census claim
assumptions.electricity_activity_elasticity: Zero-intercept log growth fit against real GDP, 2005-2014 only, after declared intensity trend; separate from calibrated direct-fuel service elasticity
assumptions.archetype_warning: Fuel residuals are aggregate service proxies, not observed sector allocation; source sector tables include transformation and are not summed as final use
assumptions.nonenergy_warning: Initial non-energy fractions are assumptions, kept in primary energy and excluded from combustion; IPPU uses separate BTR bridge; inspect +/-50%
assumptions.fuel_capacity_warning: Annual averages x explicit peak-deliverability headroom are engineering bounds, not observed hourly delivery rates
assumptions.renewable_tariff_basis: Explicit historical supported-price reconstruction, declining linearly to the 2021 common reference. Not a recovered province/project subsidy schedule; +/-20% structural check. Added after 2015-16 mechanical smoke test and before train search/holdout evaluation.
assumptions.price_warning: Constant real 2024 CNY reference prices; 449 originates in 2022 coal market mean and is an explicit all-technology tariff proxy, not universal actual settlement
assumptions.chronology_warning: Deterministic representative day, perfect information within 24h, cyclic state; no seasonal adequacy or probabilistic reliability conclusion
assumptions.storage_warning: Initial source-sized new-type storage with explicit age reconstruction. New units start empty; inherited SOC is reduced by recorded retirement disposal. Repeated cyclic representative days do not measure seasonal adequacy.
assumptions.other_cost_warning: Hydro/oil/biomass capex and solar/hydro fixed O&M are author engineering assumptions; +/-30% joint financial stress test
assumptions.ets_warning: Annual decisions use the 2026 published benchmark from 2027; 2021-2026 proxies retained. No exact firm compliance, heating corrections or allowance banking asserted.
assumptions.primary_bridge: Fixed initial-year PEO accounting equivalent; both proxy and physical direct-equivalent denominator reported. Not a claim of exact official future nonfossil share.
assumptions.carbon_bridge_warning: BTR2021 process+waste extended by GDP^0.5 and 2% intensity decline; net CO2 land removals held at 1.346499 Gt; no negative-emission technology assumed. 2005 same BTR CO2 baseline. Not all-GHG neutrality
assumptions.biomass_warning: Biogenic combustion treated as inventory memo item; feedstock finite, no negative emissions; not a lifecycle carbon-neutrality assertion
assumptions.mechanism_parameter_status: Author structural assumptions, not newly verified national measurements. Bound tests required for equity, grid headroom/build, construction elasticity, demand terminal elasticity. No empirical evidence is fabricated.
assumptions.direct_carbon_coverage_basis: Aggregate fuel archetypes cannot identify ETS-covered industrial output; no new direct coverage asserted in S0. Nonzero coverage is a labelled mechanism counterfactual, with explicit settlement; electricity generator coverage follows separate existing benchmarks.
assumptions.finance_basis: Project equity 25%: sponsor cash 5%, external shareholders 20%, debt 75%; all commitments share GDP investment envelope. Cash/arrears and collateral limit sponsor approval. Financing assumptions require stress tests, not company observations.
assumptions.collateral_basis: Initial asset costs reconstructed at initial-year reference prices; later projects at committed cost; straight-line remaining economic life. New equipment price falls do not automatically rewrite old asset loan collateral.

revision_5_disclosure: Mechanism repair before refitting: cash/equity/debt service, independent grid construction, fleet-independent construction capacity, realised curtailment feedback, covered carbon bids separated from resource cost, persistent inventory. Already-seen evaluation remains reused; thresholds unchanged. Training-only first repair failed solar (46% MAPE). Revised pledgeable project collateral, explicitly split sponsor/shareholder equity, and added bounded independent manufacturing-capability growth parameter before evaluating the revised model. First repaired holdout fails wind/solar (26%/30%); long-run oversupply persists. Add incremental sales profitability audit before investment; no post-initial physical observations used. Holdout remains already-seen. Retain original grid points and refine neighbouring training optima; select exclusively by original weighted training loss. Broaden investment-response upper bound to test prior boundary optimum. No holdout-based parameter selection. Incremental-sales model reduces long-run solar but still fails solar holdout: replacement-price collateral automatically shuts profitable investment when new equipment gets cheaper. Replace with cohort book cost and depreciation; retain all prior runs. Parallel independent training candidates preserve deterministic order and original loss.
